precise_versioned_corrections.after: While Alice remains SMALL, the next defense card she plays has +1 value. The bonus modifies a card value; it supplies no defense when she plays no card.

proposed_additions.novelty: distinct card-present/card-absent eligibility branch of Alice SMALL ability
proposed_additions.question: SMALL Alice is attacked with value 4, declines to play any defense card, and has enough health to survive. With no other effects, does SMALL reduce the damage to 3? State the attack damage, combat winner, and why.
proposed_additions.expected_answer: No. Alice takes all 4 attack damage and the attacker wins. SMALL adds 1 to a played defense card’s value; with no defense card there is no card value to modify.
required_facts: No defense card means no SMALL +1 bonus or automatic damage reduction
Attacker wins because the attack itself dealt damage
source_refs: rulebook p12 defense-card subtraction and winner from attack damage
